header.shortDesc: At ages 2-5, kids are developing essential oral care habits that will set the stage for a lifetime of healthy smiles. SuperMouth’s dentist-designed systems for this age group are specially crafted to provide the right care for growing mouths, making brushing fun while ensuring teeth and gums stay clean and protected. From teaching proper brushing techniques to introducing your child to oral care superheroes, each product is designed to engage children while delivering effective oral care. Choose the system that best fits your child’s needs: the Basic System offers essential daily care, while the Complete System provides full-mouth care for a strong foundation.

items.q: Why is it important to use an oral care system during the 2-5 years stage?
items.a: At this stage, your child’s baby teeth are crucial for their overall development. Baby teeth help with chewing and eating, which supports proper nutrition, and they are essential for clear speech and building confidence. They also hold space for the permanent teeth and guide their proper eruption. Just like adult teeth, baby teeth need the best care to ensure your child’s long-term oral health. Additionally, during this time, your child’s oral microbiome is still developing. Our system is specifically designed to protect and care for these important teeth while nurturing the oral microbiome, laying the foundation for a healthy smile and overall well-being as your child grows.

items.q: Why should I choose a system versus buying individual products?
items.a: Our systems are expertly curated by leading dentists and medical experts to ensure that every product works together to provide a complete oral care solution for your child. Purchasing a system offers the best price and additional value, including educational content to support your child’s oral health journey. Plus, our systems work perfectly on a subscription basis, so you’ll never run out of essential products, ensuring consistent care for your child’s teeth.

items.q: How long does a System last?
items.a: Each System is designed to last 90 days — 3 full months — for the average user. Subscriptions deliver a fresh box every 90 days, with monthly or quarterly payment options, and you can adjust your delivery schedule anytime if your family uses more or less.

items.q: How can I help my child brush effectively at this stage when they typically only brush 25% of their teeth?
items.a: Many children at this age only brush 25% of their teeth properly, making it important to use our system along with accessories that teach and encourage proper brushing and flossing techniques. Our systems include augmented reality magic and fun products that turn brushing into an adventure. Consider adding our music toothbrushes, which have been shown to make kids brush 73% longer, as well as toothpaste dispensers and other engaging tools to make oral care something your child looks forward to.

items.q: What accessories can I purchase to complement my 2-5 years system?
items.a: To enhance your 2-5 years system, consider adding our music toothbrushes, character-based toothpaste and floss dispensers, mouthcare organizers, safe and innovative soaps and accessories, and other fun products that make brushing and flossing enjoyable. These accessories not only improve your child’s technique but also help build lifelong healthy habits.

items.q: How can I make oral care fun for my child and the whole family?
items.a: Make brushing time an adventure by engaging with our superheroes and supervillains! We suggest gathering the family, grabbing some popcorn (and floss), and watching our heartwarming movie, The Rise of SuperMouth. You can find it on our play page. We promise you’ll laugh, cry, and floss before bedtime!
